Jobs in Manchester

There are 181 jobs in Manchester.

Located in the North of the UK, there are many jobs in Manchester up for grabs. There are a number of shopping areas in Manchester, making it a top destination for visitors from all around the world. From the famous Trafford Centre to Exchange Square, there is a shopping location to suit everyone and a plethora of jobs for students. There is also a number of cultural interests to see in the city, such as the Manchester Jazz Festival, which attracts big-named bands from a number of countries. To find out about the fantastic student jobs in Manchester, see the roles below and start applying!

Science Jobs in Manchester

Bar and waiting jobs are a great way to earn money in a fun working atmosphere. If you have good people skills and like a busy environment, this is the role for you! Bar and waiting jobs are guaranteed to improve your skills, making you an ideal candidate for future employers. Manchester has a number of bars and restaurants looking for new employees, so see our jobs below and sign up for free to StudentJob today!

Science Jobs in Manchester

Customer Service Jobs in Manchester

These customer service jobs are ideal for students as they will give you the problem-solving skills for any working environment. Your main responsibility will be to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction by trying to come up with the best possible solution to any problems they are experiencing after using your product/service. And, you will have to answer any questions they have in a friendly manner. If you like working with people and dealing with customer enquiries, this is the ideal role for you! To find out more about the customer service jobs that StudentJob has in Manchester, see our vacancies below and apply today!

How do we rank vacancies?

Job Vacancy Ranking

To provide users with the most relevant results, our search engine applies a two-step process for displaying vacancies:

1. Filtering: Vacancies are first filtered based on your search criteria (e.g., keywords, radius, employment type, and salary). Any vacancy that does not meet these mandatory requirements is excluded from the results.
2. Ranking: Remaining vacancies are ranked based on a composite relevance score, calculated using the following factors:

Textual Relevance: We analyze how well your keywords match the job posting. Matches within the job title carry the highest weight, followed by the short description and general text.

Recency & Proximity: New vacancies and those located closer to your search location are prioritized. The relevance score decreases as the posting date becomes older or the distance from the search center increases.

Commercial Prioritization: Certain vacancies may be prioritized due to commercial agreements. This includes 'TopJobs' (paid promotions), employers using a 'boost' feature, or vacancies posted directly by our partners compared to third-party external sources.
